The SUE Programming Interface

SUE API Procedures
Generic Procedures
get_assoc <name> <list>
min <num> [<num> ...] max <num> [<num> ...]
pp_number <num> [<format "%g%s">]
parse_pp_number <string>
setl <var_list> &ltlist>
use_first <var_list>
SUE-Specific Procedures
bus_expand <name>
bus_width <name>
exit [-force]
menu_add -menu (file|edit|view|sim|help) -label <name> -command <command> -hotkey <hotkey> -help <string>
unique_name <prefix> <primary_name> <secondary_name>
